expectations.text: PRD/SPEC 固化人工确认与人工降级
expectations.evidence: The blueprint explicitly makes AI output draft-only, enforces server-side human confirmation, and preserves manual chat when the model fails.

expectations.text: SPEC 覆盖流式、检索、越权和重复发送异常
expectations.evidence: The blueprint discusses connection recovery, access isolation and message idempotency, but does not define complete observable scenarios for stream interruption and knowledge retrieval returning no usable result.

expectations.text: 架构分别论证中间件并给出移除条件
expectations.evidence: A dedicated table states when cache, queue, realtime and model providers are needed or should not be used, with staged recommendations.

expectations.text: 安全文档覆盖 AI 数据和提示注入风险
expectations.evidence: The document covers no-training provider terms, tenant-aware retrieval, prompt injection, output checks and denial of arbitrary tool calls.

expectations.text: 部署门禁监控性能、并发、质量、成本和降级
expectations.evidence: Launch criteria and delivery phases cover first-token latency, 3000/6000 connections, AI quality, ¥50k cost and model failure/manual degradation.

uncertainties: Detailed latency and monthly budget allocations are proposed without provider measurements.

eval_feedback.overall: Excellent compact baseline; the principal gap is scenario-level behavioral completeness and traceability.
